name: Himuro Suzuka
source:
A lively and cheerful high-school girl who is the youngest member of the Himuro family.

Unlike her big brother, she's very sociable and claims to be friends with almost every high-schooler in Tenkaiku.

Despite her appearance, she possesses incredible strength. 
Her weapon of choice is a 100kg iron bat with adorable decorations.

Her dream is to live happily with everyone from the Hakurou-gumi

Part of Hakurou-gumi
